content.content:
Never-Sold: "The Chainbreakers buy out Owings, debts paid in work, at what they were first set. There is a woman north of Blackrose called Rows-For-Another. Eleven years ago she damaged one of an estate's boats. The estate's steward assessed her an Owing of four months' work. She works it still. I have put by what that Owing was at first: one hundred gold. By custom an Owing paid at its first price is closed. It is never mentioned again. Take the coin. If you can talk the steward round without it, keep it. From here take the swamp road north out of Blackrose. The channel bank is a short walk on. The steward Hulm-Tei stands there with his book. Rows-For-Another has looked at that channel for years, and the buy-out is not her only way off the estate. Ask her what the other way would cost. Hear what she wants before you do anything."
